title: Omni-Ingest Workflow Manifest
description: Schema for Stage 1 (Detect) workflow manifest — the intake record for every content entering the omni-ingest pipeline. Produced by detectors (webhook, cron_rss, file_drop, email, arxiv, user_submit). Consumed by all downstream stages.

workflowId.description: Unique workflow identifier. Used as the primary key for all bus/ledger files.

stage.description: Stage that emitted this manifest. Always '01-detect' for new workflows.

triggeredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC when the trigger was fired.

sourceRef.description: Canonical reference to the original content (URL, file path, IMAP UID, arXiv ID, etc.).

contentTypeHint.description: MIME type hint from the detector (may be overridden by Stage 2 normalization).

userInstructions.description: Optional human instructions passed through from user_submit or webhook payload.

signature.description: HMAC signature from webhook for payload verification.

originalFilename.description: Original filename if applicable (email attachment, uploaded file, etc.).

mtime.description: Last-modified time of the source content.

checksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw content for deduplication.

retryCount.description: Number of times this workflow has been retried.

parentWorkflowId.description: If this workflow was spawned by another (e.g., sub-agent result processing), reference to the parent.
